notes.title: BIGGEST AND NEWEST UPDATE EVER
notes.content:
Hello everyone. The game is now 18 gigs large versus 80 gigs. Greatly improved overall game play such as the following:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sb3Etm9qA20&t=51s

New Hud
Own rights to music
99 percent A.I bug free
Greatly improved Level Design. The openlands level still needs work 
New weapons
Gamepad support available now
Game will play from start to finish
More enemies
More levels
New spells and all spells and all spells work
You can now shoot a power spell from a distance at the enemy and it works. Left trigger or Key #2
Save function does not save automatically you must find the save spots yourself now.
So much more.

Basically everyone besides a few level design flaws mostly in the openworld the game is virtually done, besides adding in the rest of the story, which is going to finally be our main focus on the game, and within less than 2 months this game should be fully done!

notes.title: Update Released!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We are excited to announce that all the new content that we have shown off will now be released. We are currently working on packaging the game as we type this!

Check out the new offical trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YluP4SE968c

New Enemies
Advanced A.I
New hit effects
100's of bug fixes.
Better storyline

Will announce when the new update has been released.

notes.title: New info on the update coming out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just wanted to let everyone know we are still on track for the update being released before X-mas if not sooner. We just want to remind everyone that content shown in the new videos has yet to be released and to expect to see a lot more new content coming out with the update. Epic has been great releasing new content on a daily basis on their marketplace and we have been taking full advantage of this, along with gaming the game a complete over hull, specifically working on much more graphical detail throughout the game and focusing on FPS. With a 1050 Graphics card We are running the game virtually on EPIC settings and still getting well above 30 FPS to 70FPS in some areas. 

Hope everyone has a good Thanksgiving weekend. We are currently working right now!

notes.title: Biggest update ever
notes.content:
Alright everyone. I am very excited to announce the biggest update ever. I have uploaded a brand new video on the store page that shows the Dragon King Boss fight as an example. Not only have I worked on the play mechanics of the game to really bring you a hard core hack and slash RPG game, I have also down drastic work on the overall level design which you can see an preview of whats to come in the link below. I have also fixed over 1300 bugs. As you can see from both the videos The Sacred Stone is really becoming a work of art, and am really going to be bringing you gamers something very unique and beautiful to play. I expect the new update to be out before X-mas.

EPIC SETTINGS Are shown in the video, Expect the Effects are set to Medium. GTX 1050

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4Ztf9EzuPk

-Better Character Design
-Better Animations
-Better hub
-More Spells
-Better Combat
-Enemies A.I greatly improved
-Sound Effects for player and A.I
-New Intro to the game: This is pretty hard core you will see!
-HardCore Boss fights
-Improved Level up system
-Improved Lighting
-Improved Landscaping
-Story flows better
-More combat and enemies in game
-Boss fights contain their own level design area for maximing FPS Rate

notes.title: Update finally out!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
We have a decent update out. We have fixed the beginning of the game. We have done a lot of work on the overall open world. By next month we should have the open world almost finished which means we are going to be focusing the rest of the play mechanics and finishing the game. We have a target date for the game to be fully finished by Xmas of 2018. 

There will be quite a few updates from this point on. We will keep you posted on what those are!

notes.title: Update 4.7 Coming out 6/23/18
notes.content:
Check out the new video guys on the store page here. It is the first video! Massive amount of work done. 

New Textures for the characters
57 new animations
New animations for the main character
6 New textures for the main character
2 different fight styles Spear/Swords
New Enemy Animations for the skeleton warriors
5 New enemies in Game.
New Spells in game

Combo system in game: Instead of clicking the left mouse button keys Shift, X,F and more to come all command a certain sword skill. 

I have also added in a dash system with a teleport effect built into it. A little buggy but I am woring on it.  

Improved the overall layout of the open world, along with lighting effects, fog, better layout, more meshes, and much more. 

Fixed some other minor bug issues. 

Still balancing out the game at this time as far as game content goes. Some enemies may be to strong/ to weak depending on how well you have leveled up.

notes.title: New Build 2.1 OUT!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. So lets dive right into what is new and fixed!

Fixed some floating buildings,
Floating doors
Lighting issues
Some health issues.
Some other mesh issues.

Whats new!?
A new level
More story
Combo system!!! Use right click to use combos!
Crossbow!!!! Hit R once locked onto the target to fire your crossbow! This is a bit buggy but I am working on getting the player to face the enemy when firing the crossbow everytime.

Fixed some sound issues, with music and sounds over lapping. 

Fixed the level streaming issues with the opening scene with the queen. 

Fixed some other little tweaks, and bugs as well. 

Hope you all enjoy! Please let us know what else we can improve on!

notes.title: First review issues fixed with camera!
notes.content: Hello everyone, made some tweaking with the camera. I am still not 100 percent sure about the right mouse that he is referring too, but am figuring that out with him. I took out the y axis, and set camera lower and made some other tweaks as well, including with the targeting system when selecting an enemy. Game should be fully playable now, and I have to agree the camera system which I did mention in the early access  section needs work is virtually complete now. So I hope you all enjoy. New build will be up before midnight tonight. The game is building.

notes.title: Welcome everyone please read
notes.content:
Hello everyone I am here to answer any questions you may have! A few things that I would like to let everyone know.
 I am creating a bug report forum. This means if you want to report a bug please do so in the bug report forum when you see it posted here very shortly. Please do not post in other forums, it will only delay the process of fixing any issues!

I will also be creating a general discussion tab. Feel free to ask questions here. 

I will also be creating an exclusive behind the scenes forums. So only people that own the game can have access to it.

All press inquires please email panzergamingstudios@gmail.com 

Feel free to shoot me an email as well if you want to keep something private or just want to say hi!
